pilot_objective: Measure real-world classification concordance, escalation safety, operational reliability, and canary qualification in production shadow mode.

shadow_mode_invariants.authoritative_workflow: Normal human triage remains the sole authoritative production path. NEXUS-SLM operates as a passive shadow mirror.
shadow_mode_invariants.execution_bar: NEXUS-SLM is structurally barred from executing customer-facing actions, initiating refunds, altering account states, or sending external communications.
shadow_mode_invariants.failure_isolation: Inference timeouts, queue congestion, or service errors are failure-isolated and cannot block or delay human triage.

data_governance_and_privacy.pii_redaction: All tickets sanitized via PrivacyRedactor prior to shadow inference. Credit card numbers, CVVs, passwords, tokens, phone numbers, and emails are replaced with safety tokens.
data_governance_and_privacy.telemetry_logging: TelemetryLogger records operational metadata only (latency, categories, confidences, status). Full ticket text and secrets are strictly excluded from logs.
data_governance_and_privacy.data_quarantine: Prospective pilot tickets are quarantined in data/pilot/ and forbidden from being added to training data (data/train/) or validation splits without versioned branching.

blinding_rules: Human reviewers must not see model category predictions, priorities, confidence scores, or escalation flags.
Reviewers submit independent ground truth based solely on customer ticket text and the 14-class taxonomy definition.
Submitted labels are timestamped, reviewer-signed, and frozen into immutable JSONL files with SHA256 verification before comparison with model outputs.
ground_truth_labeling_protocol.sample_stratification: Sampling must include both high-risk challenge vectors and routine negative controls to measure both safety recall and over-escalation precision.

classification_metrics.category_accuracy: Proportion of exact category matches between human and model.
classification_metrics.macro_f1: Unweighted mean F1 score across all 14 taxonomy classes.
classification_metrics.weighted_f1: Support-weighted mean F1 score across all 14 classes.
classification_metrics.category_concordance: Direct human-model agreement rate with 95% Wilson score confidence intervals.

escalation_safety_metrics.escalation_precision: True Positives / (True Positives + False Negatives + False Positives)
escalation_safety_metrics.false_negative_safety_escapes: Critical count of high-risk tickets where human=True but model escalated=False.
escalation_safety_metrics.false_positive_rate: Proportion of routine safe queries conservatively escalated.

gate_1_pilot_duration.requirement: Minimum 14 consecutive calendar days of active shadow operation.

gate_2_minimum_volume.requirement: Minimum 5,000 prospective production tickets evaluated in shadow mode.

gate_3_high_risk_escalation_recall.requirement: Escalation recall on prospectively labeled high-risk tickets >= 98.0%.

gate_4_safety_escapes.requirement: Zero Sev-1 safety escapes on fraud, legal, security lockout, or tampering tickets.

gate_6_remote_ci_workflow.requirement: 100% passing remote Linux Docker build, container healthcheck, and graceful shutdown test.

sev1_incident.definition: A high-risk ticket (fraud, account compromise, legal notice) is misclassified and fails human escalation.
sev1_incident.action: Immediate suspension of shadow pilot and rollback to heuristic baseline within 5 minutes.

sev2_incident.definition: Escalation rate drifts outside 20%-65% band, or service error rate exceeds 1.0%.

recovery_mechanisms: API level toggle to heuristic baseline via /model/rollback (RTO < 30s).
